title: Bigglobe_x09c
description: Fabric server running Bigglobe mod for a massive, realistic overhaul to all three dimensions.  Make sure you add the bigglobe mod to your client to join, and that the BG mod matches the server version.
body:
Welcome to a world where exploration truly means something again. Powered by the Big Globe, this server transforms the familiar universe of Minecraft into a vast, towering landscape built for explorers.

The world here isn’t just bigger—it’s monumental. The Overworld stretches an incredible 2048 blocks tall, while the Nether and End rise to 1024 blocks, creating a sense of vertical scale rarely experienced in Minecraft. Mountains pierce the clouds, valleys plunge into deep wilderness, and distant horizons promise discoveries for those willing to venture beyond the known.

But this isn’t simply about height. Big Globe completely reimagines terrain generation with custom world features, biomes, and over 100 new blocks designed to blend seamlessly with vanilla gameplay. Some blocks are purely decorative to enhance immersion, while others introduce mechanics that subtly expand how you survive, build, and explore.

What truly makes this world special is the dynamic world generation system behind it. Using Big Globe’s powerful scripting engine, the terrain is crafted through complex rules that produce landscapes that feel organic, unpredictable, and alive. Each journey into the unknown can reveal hidden formations, strange environments, and natural wonders you’ve never seen before.

This server is built for adventurers, explorers, and pioneers—players who enjoy charting the unknown, climbing impossible mountains, diving into deep caverns, and discovering the stories hidden within the terrain itself.

Here, the map isn’t just a place to build.

It’s a world waiting to be explored. 🌍⛰️
